reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR on the front, and that is what everyone says. I would not buy off a creator video, because I have no way to know the QR report is real or that it matches the box in my hand.
objection: "Lab-tested" and a QR code are claims until I can see a real report with a lab name I can check and a batch number that matches my box. A creator video is an ad, not proof, and I would rather buy a known brand that already has third-party certification.
would_change_my_mind: If I could scan the QR before ordering and see a real, dated report from a lab I can look up, with the actual magnesium result next to the label claim, I would try one box.
